symbols.name: coefficient count
symbols.meaning: The number of complex coefficients of a reduced polynomial, which is a power of two.
symbols.quote: Here $r$ is the number of complex coefficients of a reduced polynomial, a power of two.

symbols.name: polynomial variable
symbols.meaning: The formal variable of the polynomial ring modulo y^r+1, whose powers are the roots of unity on this page.
symbols.quote: Here $y$ is the formal variable of the [polynomial ring modulo $y^r+1$](polynomial-ring.md), changing meaning from the neighbouring vertex of earlier pages.

symbols.name: power exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent of a power of y being multiplied, with 0 < p < r.
symbols.quote: Here $p$ is an exponent with $0 < p < r$.

relations.predicate: is multiplied at each twiddle step
relations.quote: A [discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) multiplies by a root of unity at each [twiddle step](fourier-transform.md), a general complex product.
